title: Only 30% of a Cow Makes This Hotpot — Timed to the Second | China Travel Expert
description:
Only about 30% of a cow is good enough for Chaoshan beef hotpot — and every cut is boiled to its own exact second.

Chaoshan beef hotpot comes from eastern Guangdong, near Shantou. The beef is prized for freshness: it can reach the pot within about 3–4 hours of slaughter, never frozen. A clear, light broth (no chili) lets the meat lead, and each cut has its own blanching time — some go in for as little as 8 seconds before they're pulled out. The most prized cut, the marbled "snowflake" neck (脖仁), makes up less than 0.2% of a whole cow.

🧭 Expert Tip: Order the snowflake neck cut (脖仁) first while the broth is cleanest, and follow the shop's timing card — the seconds on it are not a suggestion.

潮汕牛肉火锅：一头牛只有约三成能上桌，现宰几小时内到锅，每个部位烫多少秒都掐着表。
